claims.claim: MAS issued revised Notice 656 for banks on 4 Sep
claims.reason: S1 lists MAS Notice 656 and MAS Notice 656 (Amendment No.2) 2026, both dated 4 September 2026. The amendment takes effect on 4 Sep 2027. The notice is addressed to banks incorporated in Singapore.

claims.claim: MAS issued revised Notice 643 for banks on 4 Sep
claims.reason: S2 says MAS Notice 643 (Amendment) 2026 was issued on 4 Sep 2026 as a Notice to Banks. It takes effect on 4 Sep 2027.

claims.claim: MAS issued revised Notice 643A for banks on 4 Sep
claims.reason: S3 says MAS Notice 643A (Amendment) 2026 was issued on 4 September 2026 as a Notice to Banks. It is effective 4 Sep 2027.
Consultation P015-2026 on amending the Payment Services Act for stablecoins was published on 1 Sep 2026.
Both sources give 16 October 2026 as the closing date. This is a deadline stated in a source published before the run date, not an event reported after it.

S4: the Financial Services and Markets (Amendment) Bill 2026 was moved for First Reading. It inserts a new Division 3 empowering MAS to impose TLAC requirements on systemically important FIs. The answer's wording fits a bill that has been introduced, not enacted.
